responsibility: Declares the public interface for the bootstrapped GNU Modula-2 ASCII module by exporting the compile-time character constant macros for control codes and common aliases used by the rest of the pge-boot runtime. Unlike the companion implementation file, this header is the inclusion point that gives other modules access to the canonical ASCII_nul/lf/cr/tab/del definitions without owning any runtime behavior.
same_name_distinction: This file is the public include interface for the ASCII module, exporting the ASCII_* macros under include guards for other translation units. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GASCII.cc, it contains no module init/fini code or standalone implementation body.
